name: HoneycombPlus Active Palette

Darkest.role: Deep amber border, mortar lines, and recessed shadow

Dark.role: Rich amber secondary shadow and bevel edge

MidDark.role: Warm honey-orange lower midtone for wax grain

Mid.role: Base honeycomb gold primary surface fill

MidLight.role: Bright honey gold upper midtone and inner bevel

Bright.role: Specular wax highlight and outer lamp/lantern glow

GlowCore.role: Incandescent light core for lantern and lit lamp

IronDark.role: Warm dark bronze-iron housing for lantern and lamp frame

IronMid.role: Warm mid bronze-iron for lantern cap and chain

Redstone.role: Powered redstone indicator on Honeycomb Lamp
